endpoints.dbModeBehavior: Requires admin bearer auth and returns the configured multi-source external collection scheduler cadence and the in-memory status snapshot for the active backend process without changing the public /api/health contract.

Admin-only manual operation endpoint. Fetches configured official external policy sources, upserts external_source_records, promotes public-eligible records into policies (including local_half_trip active/scheduled rows), maps source HTTP 404/410 to per-source source_unavailable, treats traffic_benefit as optional legacy, and returns per-source success/error details without exposing secrets.

Requires admin bearer auth, summarizes official external benefit records from external_source_records, and includes a recommendationPreview generated by the existing region recommendation service without performing a live network fetch. dateDiagnostics contains machine-readable counts for unsafe policy date normalization cases including default-like dates, unclassified ranges, same-type conflicts, budget caveats, and source starts missing from canonical start_date.

Validates required terms/privacy agreements, sends verification email, and stores pending signup with agreement metadata only after email delivery succeeds; does not create users until /api/auth/signup/complete.
Validates a pending signup token and returns the verified email without creating a user or setting a refresh cookie.
Consumes a valid pending signup token with a password, creates the user, returns AuthResponse, and sets the refresh cookie.

Returns available=false when an active user with the same email exists. Withdrawn users are ignored because withdrawal anonymizes users.email to withdrawn-{id}-{timestamp}@withdrawn.local; the original email can sign up again.
Rotates a valid refresh cookie into a new AuthResponse. If the token's user is withdrawn or otherwise inactive, revokes that refresh token and returns 401 without issuing a new token.

Requires an active authenticated user with password_hash. Verifies currentPassword, updates users.password_hash, revokes the user's existing refresh tokens, forbids extra request fields, returns 400 for passwordless accounts, and returns 401 for missing auth, withdrawn users, or wrong current password.

Requires an active authenticated user. Password users must send only password; OAuth-only/passwordless users must send only confirmationPhrase='탈퇴합니다'. Soft-withdraws the user by setting users.withdrawn_at and HMAC users.withdrawn_email_hash, anonymizing email to withdrawn-{id}-{timestamp}@withdrawn.local, changing nickname to 탈퇴한 사용자 #{id}, clearing password_hash/profile preferences/social_accounts, revoking refresh tokens, clearing the refresh cookie, preserving related rows and password_reset_tokens, rejecting extra fields, and allowing the original email to re-sign up because active lookups ignore withdrawn users.

Always returns requested=true for valid email shape. Stores only a SHA-256 reset token hash and sends SMTP only for active users with password_hash; nonexistent, passwordless/OAuth-only, and withdrawn users get the same response without token creation.

Validates the hashed token, rejects expired/used/unknown tokens, rejects tokens whose user is withdrawn or passwordless, updates users.password_hash, marks the token used, and revokes existing refresh tokens. Existing password_reset_tokens rows remain stored across soft withdrawal but fail closed at confirm time.

endpoints.requiredBehavior: Sets OAuth state HttpOnly cookie and redirects to the Kakao authorization URL. Unsupported providers return 404 and missing provider config returns 503.
Sets OAuth state HttpOnly cookie and redirects to the Google OpenID Connect authorization URL. Unsupported providers return 404 and missing provider config returns 503.

On existing active social user or verified same-email active user link success, validates code/state, links social_accounts as needed, sets the refresh cookie, clears the OAuth state cookie, and redirects to frontend /oauth/callback?redirect={safePath}. Withdrawn users are fail-closed because social account and same-email lookups use active-user paths only. For a new social account, does not create a user or set refresh cookie; creates pending_social_signups and redirects to frontend /signup/social-agreement?token={token}&redirect={safePath}. Same-email auto-link requires verified provider email; Google requires email_verified=true, while Kakao without usable verified email may use kakao_{providerId}@oauth.local in the pending signup. On terminal failure, does not set a refresh cookie, clears the OAuth state cookie where possible, and redirects to frontend /oauth/callback?error={access_denied|invalid_state|provider_unavailable|profile_unavailable|email_policy}&redirect={safePath} without exposing provider error_description.

endpoints.dbModeBehavior: Reads an active pending_social_signups row by token hash and returns display-only provider/email/nickname metadata plus the persisted safe redirect path without creating a user.

Validates active pending social signup token and current required agreements, creates users/social_accounts only after agreement, deletes the pending row, returns AuthResponse, and sets the refresh cookie.
Requires bearer auth for an active user. Withdrawn users are rejected by get_current_user before this DTO is returned.
Requires bearer auth and returns a non-persisted random nickname suggestion.
Requires bearer auth, trims the nickname, validates length 2-20, and updates users.nickname.

Updates users.preferred_regions, users.travel_style, and users.travel_budget, then marks onboarding_completed true. Explicit null or an empty preferredRegions array clears the corresponding unset preference. Unknown extra request fields are rejected with 422.
Marks onboarding complete without persisting profile field selections and records that the profile step was explicitly skipped.

Ranks public recommendation-eligible external_source_records rows by active fresh regional policy count, ending-soon count, explicit KRW value, style as a non-overriding tie breaker, and profile region only as the final tie breaker. preferredRegions accepts up to three 17-sido values and, when provided, reserves one candidate per selected region before score-order fill; nationwide records are included only as fallback when regional candidates are fewer than limit. local_half_trip records count directly, while stay_discount records are expanded from raw_payload.eligibleAreas into regional alias candidates so the canonical stay policy is not counted as an extra +1. Legacy regional_benefit and traffic_benefit evidence is excluded from public recommendation scoring.

Returns official-benefit Policy DTOs from DB policies only. local_half_trip active/scheduled rows, official participating `digital_tourism_resident_card` active/scheduled rows, and active/fresh stay_discount external_source_records are promoted into policies by the collection normalization service. Source semantics are classified only by registered sourceCategory mappers: stay_discount maps discounts, issue/usage periods, product/OTA/stay constraints, required-document evidence, and early-close notices into the five structuredDetail sections; unknown categories fail closed without promoting contact_text or raw detail into requirements. local_half_trip keeps backward-compatible travelmonth-{externalSourceRecordId} slugs, formats titles with bracketed municipality prefixes such as `[합천] 대한민국 반값여행 지원`, and returns screen-ready supportContent/applicationTarget/requiredDocuments/notes with benefit-application conditions in supportContent, eligibility-only applicationTarget enriched from municipality detail-page participation target fields when available, municipality-specific proof guidance, and official-notice caveats; confirmed digital tourism resident card policies remain separate from local_half_trip copy, use canonical dgtour-{city} slugs and VisitKorea dgtourcard official URLs only, using bracketed titles such as `[해남] 디지털관광주민증 혜택`; legacy dgtour-{city}-{n} and prior travelmonth-{externalSourceRecordId} URLs resolve to the same city canonical policy; non-participating cities such as 강진/남해/영암/횡성 are hidden/404. stay_discount keeps one canonical promoted policy internally, but public list/search/recommendation responses hide that canonical row and project raw_payload.eligibleAreas into stay-discount-{sidoSlug}-{citySlug} regional aliases; alias rows format titles with city prefixes such as `[고성] ...`, return broad `region` values such as `강원`/`경남`, project requirements from structuredDetail.applicationTarget, replace the first applicationTarget item with the requested alias region such as `경남 고성 등 숙박세일페스타 대상 지역 숙박 이용자`, are actionable, and omit/null actionStatus. regional_benefit is legacy summary evidence for the same half-trip program and is hidden/excluded from public policy promotion, recommendation, and raw detail fallback; traffic_benefit is optional legacy source evidence and is not promoted into public policies; digital_tourism_resident_card starts from the official 52-region allowlist, collects each region's getRegnMbrbList.json pages into raw_payload.partnerBenefits, and exposes only a screen-sized summary plus category representative partner benefits in structuredDetail.supportContent, with item-level official partner detail URLs when member IDs are available. local_half_trip records that are ended, unknown-status, or stale are hidden from public policy lists by setting policies.status to hidden when a promoted policy exists. sourceType remains in the DTO for compatibility/internal diagnostics, but user-facing UI must not expose internal/external wording and all exposed normalized policies share save/trip behavior. Policy category is a benefit/source type; TravelMonth records derive category from source URL/sourceCategory and do not use travelStyles for category filtering. Hidden policies are excluded by backend query and public Policy.status is not exposed in v1. structuredDetail is optional user-detail JSON with supportContent/periods/applicationTarget/requiredDocuments/notes sections; it is screen-ready policies.structured_detail data, not raw external_source_records.raw_payload, policy-level official/apply links are exposed through top-level officialUrl/applyUrl, while item-level structuredDetail.supportContent URLs may point to official partner-benefit detail pages, and non-empty structured applicationTarget suppresses legacy requirements reclassification. Public deadline is an existing string contract: ISO date means a safe representative deadline selected by backend period evidence, and empty string means no safe representative deadline; top-level startDate is the safe representative period start date when the same selector can confirm it, otherwise null. Source period start/end values are also preserved inside structuredDetail.periods items with period type metadata. Scoped 2026-07-16 local_half_trip corrections for travelmonth-20/24/32/21/27 use detail-URL evidence to populate supportContent, periods, applicationTarget, requiredDocuments, and notes; applicationTarget is eligibility-only, proof strings such as receipts/payment history/photos/captures/lodging confirmations stay in requiredDocuments or notes, and travelmonth-32 is hidden/needs_review so public detail/list/save/trip attachment do not expose it.

Canonical digital tourism details use dgtour-{city}. Legacy dgtour-{city}-{n} detail slugs and prior travelmonth-{externalSourceRecordId} URLs whose external source is digital_tourism_resident_card resolve to the same city canonical policy instead of redirecting to local_half_trip, preventing old pre-normalization or misclassified detail pages from reappearing; non-participating dgtour policies such as `[강진]` return 404 because they are hidden. travelmonth-{externalSourceRecordId} slugs resolve normalized TravelMonth/local_half_trip policies with bracketed municipality title prefixes such as `[합천] 대한민국 반값여행 지원` and enriched structuredDetail sections where municipality participation target fields populate applicationTarget while use/payment conditions stay out of applicationTarget, and stay-discount-{sidoSlug}-{citySlug} aliases resolve the canonical stay_discount policy. stay_discount alias detail echoes the requested alias slug, formats title with a city prefix such as `[고성] ...`, returns broad `region` values such as `강원`/`경남`, returns cleaned summary/amount/requirements copy, projects structuredDetail into the approved supportContent/periods/applicationTarget/requiredDocuments/notes screen sections, replaces the first applicationTarget item with the requested alias region, while save/remove/trip mutations persist canonical Policy.id and echo the request alias in mutation responses. A temporary raw external_source_records fallback may resolve active/fresh local_half_trip, official participating active/fresh digital_tourism_resident_card, and stay_discount detail during migration gaps, but regional_benefit, traffic_benefit, and non-active/non-fresh records do not resolve through the public fallback. Hidden policies return 404 from the public detail route. structuredDetail is optional user-detail JSON with supportContent/periods/applicationTarget/requiredDocuments/notes sections; it is screen-ready policies.structured_detail data, not raw external_source_records.raw_payload, policy-level official/apply links are exposed through top-level officialUrl/applyUrl, while item-level structuredDetail.supportContent URLs may point to official partner-benefit detail pages, and missing/empty sections preserve existing section-level fallback rendering. Raw external_source_records fallback uses the same representative deadline selector and must not expose raw record.end_date when the selector marks it unsafe; typed source periods remain in structuredDetail.periods. Scoped 2026-07-16 local_half_trip corrections for travelmonth-20/24/32/21/27 use detail-URL evidence to populate supportContent, periods, applicationTarget, requiredDocuments, and notes; applicationTarget is eligibility-only, proof strings such as receipts/payment history/photos/captures/lodging confirmations stay in requiredDocuments or notes, and travelmonth-32 is hidden/needs_review so public detail/list/save/trip attachment do not expose it.

endpoints.dbModeBehavior: Static administrative snapshot merged with curated travel areas. No runtime network call. Every registered sido returns exactly one wholeArea; recommendedAreas and administrativeAreas may be empty (세종 has no sub-areas). Administrative units are 시·군 for 도, 자치구·군 for 광역시, and 제주시·서귀포시 for 제주; non-autonomous 구 inside a 일반시 are excluded. Curated and administrative areas are never merged into one group. Unsupported sido returns 400 Unsupported travel area sido; a missing sido returns 422. Administrative options carry a group label only for sido with more than 13 units (서울, 부산, 경기, 강원, 충남, 전북, 전남, 경북, 경남); smaller sido return null on every option. administrativeAreas is ordered so one group's options are contiguous.

endpoints.dbModeBehavior: Requires owner/editor access, updates whole-trip title, travel area, and canonical date range without parsing presentation-only dates, adds missing days, and handles overflow days by moveToLastDay or delete. When travelAreaId is present it is resolved through the shared travel-area resolver and stored with trips.region in one transaction; an unknown id returns 400 Travel area not found without bumping revision. Omitting travelAreaId leaves the stored area unchanged. Changing the area does not move or delete places or days. Linked policies that no longer match the new area are judged with the same rule as attaching a policy: with mismatchedPolicyStrategy reject (default) the request returns 409 with detail {code: trip_policies_outside_travel_area, message, policies[{slug,title,hasApplicationProgress}]} and changes nothing including revision; with remove those links are deleted in the same transaction while matching and nationwide policies stay. The check only runs when travelAreaId actually changes, and a stale expectedRevision wins over it. Viewer access returns 403 Trip edit permission required.

Authenticated trip members can search Kakao Local places for selection. The endpoint returns candidate metadata only and does not mutate itinerary data; saving still uses POST /api/trips/{tripId}/days/{dayNumber}/places with expectedRevision.

Authenticated users search Kakao Local places for the unified search (home place list, policy tab 'find by location'). Not tied to a trip and mutates nothing. Keyword search, plus Kakao address search when the query ends in a dong/eup/myeon/ri/N-ga so every same-named area comes back (kind=area, listed first). Each item carries the map region (sido) and city resolved from the Kakao address server-side; 전남광주통합특별시 maps to 광주 for 구 and 전남 for 시/군. Queries shorter than 2 chars, Kakao disabled, or Kakao failures return [].

Authenticated users get up to 6 Kakao Local places of one category (FD6 food, CE7 cafe, AD5 stay, AT4 attraction) within 2 km of the point, nearest first, with distanceMeters from the point (the home place card's 'nearby' section). Kakao category search as-is: no ratings, reviews, or popularity. lat 33-39 and lng 124-132 or 422; other categories 422. Kakao disabled or failing returns [].

Authenticated users match a Kakao place they picked (name, coordinates, optional Kakao category code; no Kakao place id) against our own public place base (public_places: TourAPI six content types and SBIZ store data food/stay/arts-sports). The server compares in memory and never stores or logs the received values (debug capture always excludes place paths). Radius: TourAPI 1 km when the Kakao category is AT4/CT1, otherwise 200 m; store data always 200 m. Names compare lowercased without spaces or symbols. result=match only when exactly one same-named place is within the radius and its category fits the Kakao category (AT4: sight/culture/leisure/shopping, CT1: culture/sight/leisure, FD6/CE7: food/cafe, AD5: stay); candidates when two or more same-named places (a TourAPI row and a store row count as two), a single same-named place whose category does not fit or when the Kakao category is missing or not one of those five codes, or a partial name overlap (both names 2+ chars), nearest first, at most 3; none otherwise with an empty places array. Each place has source (tourapi|sangga), sourceId, name, address|null, latitude, longitude, category (sight|culture|leisure|stay|shopping|food|cafe), sido|null, city|null, photoUrl|null, photoLicense|null (TourAPI only), distanceMeters. latitude 33-39, longitude 124-132, name 1-100 chars or 422; 401 without login.

Returns additional place candidates for the trip, excluding places already in the itinerary. Kakao-backed candidates include official Local API map metadata such as categoryName, phone, address, coordinates, and placeUrl when available, and use sourceType=freshCandidate. New trip creation does not seed saved summaries; the current savedSummary row is a development-seed specimen rather than proven production legacy history, and future persistence requires an explicit product contract.

Lists users for admins only. Supports q, onboardingCompleted, limit, and offset. User role is exposed as user/admin.

Lists active and hidden policies for admins, sorted by policies.updated_at desc.

Creates an internal policy. sourceType, match, label, and tag are rejected. requirements are stored in policies.target_condition and documents replace policy_documents rows. Audit output contains approved non-secret create fields only and uses a stable action+target-id summary.

Updates normalized policy save fields. slug, sourceType, match, label, and tag are rejected. Editing an external policy sets adminOverrideEnabled=true only for an actual normalized change. Audit output contains changed allowlisted fields only and skips no-op updates.

Admin-only read. Supports targetType, targetId, action, limit 1..100, and offset >=0. beforeJson/afterJson keep their existing shape but new rows contain changed allowlisted fields only; forbidden nested keys and secret-like values are excluded or redacted.
Admin-only read endpoint. Summarizes external_source_records and promoted policies by generic source category without starting collection jobs or exposing source-specific controls.
Admin-only pending-candidate read. The bounded evidence excerpt and card preview are not added to public policy DTOs; full raw payload remains admin-internal.
Atomic approval of selected pending candidates or all pending candidates; conflicts approve none.
Approves one pending candidate and returns the admin-only candidate item, including bounded cardPreview evidence.
Rejects one pending candidate and returns the admin-only candidate item, including bounded cardPreview evidence.

Hides the published row and sets status none (region: benefit illustration, policy: inherits the city photo). Audit log photo_review.none.
Hides the published row and sets status pending. Audit log photo_review.reopen.

TourAPI keyword search across content types; keeps same-sido, criteria-passing, non-food (39), non-lodging (32) photos as up to 6 source=search candidates. 409/503/502 as more.
